description: This file contains utility functions for configuration management, UUID generation, and payload processing within the Opik integration module. It includes functions to read configuration files, retrieve environment variables, generate custom UUIDs, and process payload data for traces and spans.

methods.name: create_uuid7()
methods.description: Generates a custom UUID version 7 based on the current time with variant and sequence bits, including random bytes.

methods.name: Dict[str,str] _read_opik_config_file()
methods.description: Reads the Opik configuration file located at the default path and returns configuration sections as a dictionary.

methods.name: Optional[str] _get_env_variable(key: str)
methods.description: Retrieves an environment variable with a specific prefix associated with Opik.

methods.name: Optional[str] get_opik_config_variable( key: str, user_value: Optional[str] = None, default_value: Optional[str] = None )
methods.description: Retrieves a configuration variable's value, prioritizing a user value, then environment variable, then config file, then default.

methods.name: create_usage_object(usage)
methods.description: Creates a dictionary with non-None token usage metrics.

methods.name: Dict[str,Any] _remove_nulls(x: Dict[str, Any])
methods.description: Removes keys with None values from a dictionary.

methods.name: Tuple[List[Dict[str,Any]],List[Dict[str,Any]]] get_traces_and_spans_from_payload( payload: List[Dict[str, Any]] )
methods.description: Separates trace and span data from a payload list, returning them as separate cleaned lists.

ctags.name: get_opik_config_variable
ctags.signature: ( key: str, user_value: Optional[str] = None, default_value: Optional[str] = None )
